historical_notes: Illustrative plausible South German setting around 1525, no exact reconstruction claimed.
Peace admonition after mid-April; harsher text follows escalation in May, never precedes admonition.
Weingarten: oral agreement 17 April 1525; charter ratified 22 April. Negotiation was real, not universal victory.
Muentzer treated as serious reformational alternative, no demonic caricature.
